description: What changed in the cards of a list of datasets or models since a date: license status, conditions, risk flags, verification date, change log. Send slugs (up to 50) and since (YYYY-MM-DD), or store them once with save_as (subscribe=true sends notifications) and later send only watchlist_id. Registered entries come back as unverified_registered. Use before repeating an earlier conclusion; not for searching. One call counts once.

models.description: Stored with the list, not tracked yet.

save_as.description: Name to store the slugs as (API key).

watchlist_id.description: Saved list id (API key); no slugs with it.

name: check_changes
title: What changed in a list of datasets
